steps.question: In which season is a rainbow often seen in the sky?

questionMeaning.hi: आसमान में इंद्रधनुष अक्सर किस मौसम में दिखता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Aasmaan mein indradhanush aksar kis mausam mein dikhta hai?

steps.modelAnswer: A rainbow is often seen in the rainy season.

modelMeaning.hi: इंद्रधनुष अक्सर बारिश के मौसम में दिखता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Indradhanush aksar baarish ke mausam mein dikhta hai.

steps.question: How many colours are there in a rainbow?

questionMeaning.hi: इंद्रधनुष में कितने रंग होते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Indradhanush mein kitne rang hote hain?

steps.modelAnswer: There are seven colours in a rainbow.

modelMeaning.hi: इंद्रधनुष में सात रंग होते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Indradhanush mein saat rang hote hain.
